issue_eligibility.reason: The target is a NEW threshold crossing, not continuation of an already-active condition.

positive_label_rule.transition: previous sampled flux < 10 pfu AND current sampled flux >= 10 pfu
positive_label_rule.search_interval: after issue support through the exact issue+24h endpoint, inclusive

negative_label_rule.definition: eligible resolved issue with no sampled <10 to >=10 pfu transition inside the complete 24h window

scientific_boundary.allowed_claim: sampled primary-series NEW >=10 pfu crossing within 24 hours
scientific_boundary.forbidden_claim_until_validated: equivalent to an official SEP event catalogue event definition
